newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ITC 1st half net 1.81 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's ITC 1st half net 1.81 bln rupees.

text.p: Indian tobacco and hotels group ITC Ltd said on Monday that net profit rose to 1.81 billion rupees in the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) from 1.41 billion in the same period in 1995/96.
A company spokeswoman released the net profit figure over the telephone from the company's headquarters in the eastern city of Calcutta.
Sales and other figures from the first six months of the 1996/97 financial year were expected to be released later in the day.
Britain's B.A.T Industries Plc is the biggest single shareholder in ITC with 31.7 percent of the equity.
